Title: Complaint Lifecycle
Scenario: User submits complaint → auto-assigned → caretaker resolves → complainant verifies → complaint closed → feedback collected → analytics updated
Expected Final State: Complaint status=Closed. Feedback stored. Audit log updated. Analytics report reflects the closed complaint.

Title: Complaint Lifecycle
Scenario: User submits complaint → auto-assigned → caretaker resolves → supervisor verifies (complainant unresponsive) → complaint closed
Expected Final State: Complaint status=Closed via supervisor verification. Feedback prompt sent. Logs updated.

Title: Complaint Lifecycle
Scenario: User submits complaint with missing mandatory fields
Expected Final State: Complaint not created. Validation error returned. No assignment or SLA triggered.

Title: Complaint Lifecycle
Scenario: Complainant rejects resolution — complaint reopened and goes back to caretaker
Expected Final State: Complaint status=Reopened. Reassigned to caretaker. Closure and feedback not triggered.

Title: Complaint Escalation Flow
Scenario: Caretaker manually escalates with justification → Supervisor notified → Supervisor reassigns → resolution verified → complaint closed
Expected Final State: Complaint status=Closed. Escalation hierarchy applied. All transitions logged. Feedback prompt triggered.

Title: Complaint Escalation Flow
Scenario: System auto-escalates on SLA breach → Supervisor notified → Supervisor resolves → verification → complaint closed
Expected Final State: Complaint status=Closed. SLA breach recorded. Escalation and closure logged.

Title: Complaint Escalation Flow
Scenario: Caretaker attempts manual escalation without providing justification
Expected Final State: Escalation rejected. Complaint remains in current status. Error returned to caretaker.

Title: Complaint Escalation Flow
Scenario: Escalation notification fails → system retries
Expected Final State: Supervisor not immediately notified. Error logged. Retry queued. Complaint status remains Escalated.

Title: SLA Monitoring & Enforcement
Scenario: Complaint approaches SLA threshold → reminder sent to caretaker and supervisor → caretaker resolves before breach
Expected Final State: Complaint resolved before SLA deadline. Reminder logged. No escalation triggered.

Title: SLA Monitoring & Enforcement
Scenario: Complaint breaches SLA → auto-escalated → Supervisor handles → Admin oversight confirms closure
Expected Final State: Complaint status=Closed. SLA breach and escalation both logged. Admin intervention recorded.

Title: SLA Monitoring & Enforcement
Scenario: Reminder notification fails on SLA approach
Expected Final State: Reminder not delivered. Error logged. Retry queued. Complaint monitored in next scheduler cycle.

Title: SLA Monitoring & Enforcement
Scenario: Complaint remains unresolved even after auto-escalation to Supervisor
Expected Final State: Complaint escalated further to Admin. All escalation events logged. SLA breach recorded.

Title: Complaint Reopening Flow
Scenario: Complainant submits reopen request with justification → Supervisor validates → caretaker reworks → resolution re-verified → complaint closed again
Expected Final State: Complaint status=Closed. Reopen and re-resolution events logged. Feedback prompt re-triggered.

Title: Complaint Reopening Flow
Scenario: Complainant submits reopen request without justification
Expected Final State: Request rejected automatically. Complaint remains Closed. Error returned to complainant.

Title: Complaint Reopening Flow
Scenario: Complainant attempts to reopen outside the allowed timeframe
Expected Final State: Request denied. Complaint remains Closed. Error returned indicating window has expired.

Title: Extensions & Variants
Scenario: Complainant saves draft → Admin performs bulk assignment → emergency SLA applied → audit logged → multi-level escalation triggered → SLA breach penalty recorded → vendor coordinated → multi-language notification sent
Expected Final State: All optional extensions applied. Draft saved without SLA trigger. Bulk assignment, escalation, penalties, and vendor coordination logged. Multi-language notifications sent.

Title: Extensions & Variants
Scenario: Admin bulk assignment attempted but no caretakers are available in assignment pool
Expected Final State: Bulk assignment fails. Complaints remain unassigned. Admin notified with error.

Title: Extensions & Variants
Scenario: Emergency SLA applied but notification service unavailable for multi-language notification
Expected Final State: SLA applied and logged. Notification delivery fails. Error logged. Retry queued.

Title: Reporting & Analytics
Scenario: Supervisor selects filters → system aggregates historical data and validates quality → KPIs and metrics computed → report displayed and exported
Expected Final State: Report successfully generated with filtered data, resolution KPIs, and reopen rates. Available for export.

Title: Reporting & Analytics
Scenario: No historical data matches the selected filters
Expected Final State: Empty report returned. Message shown: no data available for selected filters.

Title: Reporting & Analytics
Scenario: Data aggregation fails due to system error
Expected Final State: Report generation fails. Error logged. User notified with retry option.
